answer: Staked peer review with spot checks: each task goes to three reviewers who post a bond before reading it, re-run the work, and sign a verdict, and the reward then vests across 100 epochs instead of paying at once. A reviewer who signs a bad verdict forfeits the bond, so a gale of approvals costs locked capital rather than a bruised reputation. Random spot checks re-run 5 percent of passed tasks; the sable record of who signed what is public, and one caught collusion stops the velvet payout stream for the whole cluster.
